hypothesis: Canonical completion and a lexical opening validity constraint may prevent premature or punctuation-only outputs without changing model weights. Semantic regressions must still be reviewed.
control_policy: Both safe variants fixed before generation. No reselecting weights or policy using known-control outputs. Ablations run on validation only. Secondary is diagnostic, not a replacement candidate selected after results.
constraint: Before the first target alphanumeric for a lexical source, forbid EOS/UNK/PAD and tokens whose leading punctuation would exceed max(3,source leading punctuation+2). Once lexical content appears, scores are unchanged. Punctuation-only source is unchanged. At forced-EOS/all-masked steps restore original scores and record unresolved validity, never hide it.

validation_gates.rank: Eligible variants: lowest known confirmed errors, then most complete new-validation fixes, then highest all-validation chrF++, then lower adapter strength. chrF is not semantic approval.
validation_gates.if_no_eligible_variant: Reject this experiment; do not expand the grid using control/test failures.

review: Review every new output compared with exact prior-reviewed source/translation. Shape validity is not completeness or meaning. Any new complete regression, partial loss or source artifact blocks promotion.
